summary: Ferrari N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnished with a press release of Q1 2026 results. Net revenues were €1,848M (+3% YoY), operating profit €548M (29.7% margin), net profit €413M, diluted EPS €2.33, EBITDA €722M (39.1% margin), industrial free cash flow €653M. No special-situation event such as merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change is disclosed. This is a routine earnings release confirming 2026 guidance with organic operational highlights only.
